context_requirements: Expression of imidazoline receptor subtypes (e.g., IRAS/nischarin) or alpha2-adrenergic receptors
Functional G-protein coupling to downstream signaling pathways
Presence of the drug at sufficient concentration to engage receptors
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Consistent upregulation of immediate-early genes (e.g., FOS, JUN) or other signaling markers across multiple lines
Evidence of a shared transcriptional signature that correlates with imidazoline receptor expression
